solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Language making sober actor struggle

indicators.note: to struggle is to thrash about, so the letters of the words before it are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A sober actor wrestles with a difficult foreign tongue for a role.
explanation.definitionFit: Serbo-Croat is the South Slavic tongue spoken in the former Yugoslavia, so it is an example of a language.

clue.text: Be no longer first

parts.note: EX is a former thing, someone no longer in a role
1ST, read as IST, is the ordinal abbreviation for first

explanation.surface: A nudge to give up being the leader and step back.
explanation.walkthrough: The 1 of 1ST is read as the letter I, a common crossword trick.
explanation.definitionFit: To exist is simply to have being, so the verb 'be' is a synonym.

clue.text: Memorised last of story in the bar, drunk

indicators.note: in places the letter from story inside the rearranged letters
something drunk is unsteady and jumbled, so the letters of 'the bar' are rearranged
last of takes only the final letter of the word story

explanation.surface: Someone recites a tale in a pub, word perfect though tipsy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunk' turns THE BAR into BHEART, and 'in' puts Y, the last letter of story, after its B.
explanation.definitionFit: Something known by heart has been committed to memory, so it is memorised.

clue.text: Catch bluebottle

definitions.meaning: informal for to catch or grab
old slang for a policeman, from the blue uniform

explanation.surface: An instruction to swat a big buzzing fly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bluebottle' looks like the fly, but here it is dated British slang for a police officer.
explanation.definitionFit: Cop means both to seize (cop hold of) and a police officer, once nicknamed bluebottle.

clue.text: Away three months or so, when it's cheaper

parts.note: off means away, as in 'off on holiday'
a season of the year lasts about three months

explanation.surface: Going away for a quarter of the year, at the time when travel costs less.
explanation.definitionFit: The off season is the quiet period for resorts and travel, when prices drop.

clue.text: Feeble king to use his brain

parts.note: a thin excuse or effort is a feeble one
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A weak monarch is urged to apply his intellect for once.
explanation.definitionFit: To think is to apply the mind, which is what using one's brain means.

clue.text: To perform on stage, I have to be brisk

parts.note: acting is performing on stage
I've is the contraction of I have

explanation.surface: An actor explains that performing demands energy and pace.
explanation.definitionFit: Active and brisk both describe someone lively and energetic.

clue.text: Cleric is hopeless at first in dance

indicators.note: in puts the letters before it inside the word for dance

parts.note: bop is an informal word for a dance

indicators.note: at first takes only the opening letter of hopeless

explanation.surface: A clergyman proves hopeless when he first tries dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: A bishop is a senior member of the clergy, so a cleric.

clue.text: Bird seen round loch is quail

indicators.note: round says the bird's letters go around the abbreviation

parts.note: a finch is a small songbird
L is the map abbreviation for loch, a Scottish lake

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher spots one bird by a Scottish lake and names it as a quail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quail' wants to be the bird, but it is the verb meaning to cower.
explanation.definitionFit: To quail is to shrink back in fear, which is to flinch.

clue.text: Some sweet nature, but it is liable to erupt

definitions.text: but it is liable to erupt

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A sweet-natured person may still have a temper that could blow up.
explanation.definitionFit: Etna is the active Sicilian volcano, which erupts from time to time.

clue.text: To limit error, confirms flight

parts.note: to check something is to restrain or limit it
a sin is a wrongdoing, an error

explanation.surface: An official double-checks booking details to avoid mistakes.
explanation.definitionFit: A passenger who checks in at the airport registers and confirms their place on the plane.

clue.text: One turned to reach the wine

definitions.text: One turned to reach the wine

parts.words: One turned to reach the wine
parts.note: describes the spiral tool twisted into a cork so a bottle can be opened

explanation.walkthrough: 'One turned' sounds like a person turning round, but it is a tool that is twisted.
explanation.definitionFit: A corkscrew is twisted into the cork and pulled to open a wine bottle.

clue.text: Large hole right at side of case

indicators.note: at side of places the letter for right next to the word for case

parts.note: a crate is a packing case

explanation.surface: A big gap has appeared on the right-hand side of a box.
explanation.definitionFit: A crater is a large hollow in the ground, such as one made by a bomb or meteor.

clue.text: Harvest worker extremely prone to break back

indicators.note: to break says those letters split open the word for back

parts.note: the rear is the back

indicators.note: extremely takes the outermost letters of prone

explanation.surface: A farmhand bending constantly is very likely to injure his back.
explanation.definitionFit: A reaper cuts grain at harvest time, so is a harvest worker.

clue.text: Perhaps straw one is easily taken in

definitions.meaning: a drinking straw is something you suck through

explanation.surface: Whether a straw man is easy to fool.
explanation.definitionFit: A sucker is both a gullible dupe and anything used for sucking, like a straw.

clue.text: Check girl underground gets drinking bowl

parts.note: CH is the chess abbreviation for check
Alice in Lewis Carroll's story falls down a rabbit hole; the first draft was Alice's Adventures Under Ground

explanation.surface: A potholer inspects a cave and finds a girl with an ancient cup.
explanation.definitionFit: A chalice is a goblet, a cup-shaped vessel for drinking, especially at Communion.

clue.text: Spare man ordered this to go on pasta perhaps

definitions.text: this to go on pasta perhaps

indicators.note: ordered means arranged afresh, so the letters of the words before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man spare to the meal asked for this topping for his pasta.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordered' looks like asking a waiter, but it signals rearranging.
explanation.definitionFit: Parmesan is a hard Italian cheese grated over pasta dishes.

clue.text: Waterproof being worn is red

parts.note: a mac is a British raincoat, short for mackintosh
clothes that are on are being worn

explanation.surface: A raincoat that someone is wearing turns out to be red.
explanation.walkthrough: 'red' looks like a colour but means a red wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Macon is a Burgundy wine region, and Macon rouge is a red wine from it.

clue.text: Article about the most prolific author?

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
on means about, as in a talk on a subject

explanation.surface: A piece written about the writer who has produced the most works.
explanation.definitionFit: Anon, short for anonymous, is credited with more poems and sayings than any named writer.

clue.text: Before end of parade, medals far too heavy

indicators.note: Before places the word for medals ahead of the letter from parade

parts.note: OBEs are British honours, the Order of the British Empire

indicators.note: end of takes the final letter of parade

explanation.surface: An old soldier is laden with too many medals before the end of a march past.
explanation.definitionFit: Obese describes someone very overweight, far heavier than is healthy.

clue.text: Swordsman who puts up a barrier

definitions.meaning: one who practises fencing with a sword

explanation.surface: A swordsman also builds fences.
explanation.definitionFit: A fencer is a sportsman using foil or sabre, and literally one who puts up a fence.

clue.text: Fruit drinks, just short, filled with ice

indicators.note: filled with says the frozen water goes inside the shortened word
short says the word loses its final letter

parts.note: just as an adjective means fair
taken as written

explanation.surface: Fruit drinks served in short glasses packed with ice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' trims JUST to JUS, which 'filled with' opens to take ICE.
explanation.definitionFit: Juices are the liquids pressed from fruit, served as drinks.

clue.text: Take top off slightly open pot

indicators.note: Take top off removes the first letter of the word, the top in a down entry

parts.note: a door that is ajar is slightly open

explanation.surface: Remove the lid from a pot that is already partly open.
explanation.definitionFit: A jar is a container, a pot for storing jam or other food.

clue.text: Little number donned always? This is the only chance

parts.note: NO is the short form of number
clothes donned are worn
ever means always, as in ever hopeful

explanation.surface: A small dress is always being put on, a chance not to miss.
explanation.definitionFit: Now or never describes a single opportunity that must be taken at once or lost.
